subject: Post-demo MAP: proposed realignment, owners & new target close
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@vanguardtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo MAP: proposed realignment, owners & new target close

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and the updated MAP draft attached. High level: Vanguard liked the low-latency routing demo and the dedicated pooling options, but procurement and security need slightly more time to validate the SSO/KMS flows.

Summary & asks:
- Proposed target close: 2027-07-22 (internal assumption) — we put a placeholder for the contracting window.
- Key milestones (draft):
  1) Exec sign-off on scope (Vanguard) — owner: Olivia — due 2027-07-02
  2) Security questionnaire + evidence (Vanguard) — owner: Samir — due 2027-07-09
  3) Commercial terms + internal legal review (Vanguard/Redwood) — owners: Procurement & Ben — due 2027-07-15
  4) Final contract & PO issuance — owner: Procurement — due 2027-07-22
- Dependencies we flagged: procurement SLA approvals, SOC2 evidence delivery, and a short technical validation on KMS rotation that the infra team wants to run.

Please review the attached Vanguard_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx and let me know which milestones you'd like shifted or if we should swap priorities. Next steps I recommend: Olivia confirms exec sign-off date, Samir confirms cadence for the security evidence, and Ben and I will draft the procurement checklist.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@vanguardtech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@vanguardtech.com>, VanguardTech Procurement <procurement@vanguardtech.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: proposed realignment, owners & new target close

Thanks, Hannah — good summary. Quick update from our side after today’s sync with procurement and legal: procurement is asking for an extra two weeks to review the SOW and PO language, and security wants to run an additional KMS test in our staging environment before signing off. That means the current target close of 2027-07-22 is optimistic.

Can we shift the MAP to reflect a new target close of 2027-08-05? If that helps, we can move the security evidence milestone earlier (security will start tests the week of 7/5) but procurement sign-off will likely land closer to the end of July.

Also copying procurement so they can suggest any changes to the payment schedule/outstanding legal items.

— Olivia

olivia@vanguardtech.com | +1 (617) 222-3344

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@vanguardtech.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP v3 + reordered milestones (per procurement ask)

Olivia — thanks for the heads up. I attached Vanguard_MAP_v3.xlsx which does three things:
1) Re-forecasts target close to 2027-08-05 and annotates the procurement review window (7/18–7/29).
2) Re-prioritizes security tests earlier (kickoff 7/05) so technical blockers surface before legal/commercial windows.
3) Adds contingency owners and fallbacks: if procurement needs a PO-first model we’ve indicated our billing team lead (Lauren) as point of contact to accelerate netting terms.

Key open items for Vanguard to confirm:
- Exact person who will sign the final SOW (we have "Olivia Grant" as exec sponsor but procurement needs the legal signer name).
- KMS test window availability (Samir — can you confirm 7/05–7/09?).
- Any mandatory contract clauses (data residency wording, indemnity caps) so we can flag them to legal now.

If procurement prefers a two-step rollout (pilot -> full deployment) we can split the PO into milestone-based payments. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week to walk the updated MAP.

Thanks — Ben

Confirmed updates (MAP v3):

- Milestones & owners (finalized):
  • Exec sponsor sign-off — Olivia — due 2027-07-02 (status: ok)
  • Security KMS validation (stage) — Samir — kickoff 2027-07-05, complete 2027-07-09
  • Procurement legal review window — Procurement team — 2027-07-18 to 2027-07-29
  • Commercial terms & PO issuance — Procurement — due 2027-08-05
- Contingency plan: if procurement needs more time, we will execute a 30-day pilot (pilot PO) with limited scope — Ben to draft pilot PO language by 2027-07-12.

Immediate next steps (owners & dates):

- Procurement: share any mandatory contract clauses or payment constraints — due 2027-07-12

I'll follow up early next week with the Drive link to the finalized MAP and a proposed 30-min alignment call for 7/06 or 7/07. If anyone needs an earlier slot, flag availability.

Thanks — Hannah
